title: Malicious .xml executes any command when triggering a connection via the file or automatically
author: ntauthorityroot
body_snippet:
mRemoteNG's Terminal protocol constructs a `cmd.exe /K` command by directly concatenating unsanitized connection fields into an argument string. Opening a malicious connections file triggers arbitrary OS command execution under the victim's user context.

## Affected Code

`mRemoteNG/Connection/Protocol/Terminal/Connection.Protocol.Terminal.cs`, lines 53–74:

```csharp
string sshCommand = "ssh";
if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(username))
    sshCommand += $" {username}@{_connectionInfo.Hostname}";  //...
